name: @mako/desktop
description: Mako Desktop: a thin Electron shell that loads the Mako web app and bundles the Mako Local Agent, enabling connections to databases on this machine.

scripts.dist: pnpm --filter @mako/local-agent build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm --filter @mako/local-agent build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
